title: Page 5
content_zh:
昨夜进来的时候片漆黑，如今放眼打量了下小院，倒是整理得干干净净，看来赵家靠着赵老爹的手艺，日子过得不差。

虽说赵小丫不得宠，但赵家总不可能连个子的嫁妆都没有，她给宝贝儿子娶媳妇可是狠狠的出了五十两银子，家产都去了大半。

打量了赵家半天，李大婶打定主意多少得拿回来点才成。

心里有了计较，她装模作样的用力拍着大门的门板，在寂静的清晨显得刺耳。

刘彩凤听到外头的吵闹先是皱了下眉头，接着听到李大婶的吼声，立刻回过了神，想起了她准备的场大戏。

她连忙起身推了推身旁的赵老爹，偏偏今日他睡得跟死猪似的，她才这想起，为了预防他没睡沉，起来坏事，连他都被下了药，难怪醒不来。

“没出息的东西。”刘彩凤啐了声，套了鞋子连忙出去，踏出去，立刻扬着声音装模作样的嚷道：“是谁啊？大清早上门来吵人！”

李大婶听到刘彩凤的声音，双眼亮，立刻回道：“你还不快点把我家虎子给交出来！”

“什么虎子？你不是李家嫂子吗，怎么，你找儿子找到我们赵家来了？”

“虎子昨夜说要来你们赵家找媳妇儿玩，个晚上没回去，你快点开门，把虎子叫出来。”

两人搭唱的声音在寂静的清晨特别清楚，已有几户邻近的人家被吵醒，忍不住好奇的探头瞧。

“什么虎子在我家，你可别胡说。”

“是不是，进去找不就知道。”

“真是丢人现眼。”刘彩凤看到门外聚集了人，立刻副气急败坏的样子，“赵小丫那死丫头，我就知道不安分，这才多大年纪就懂得勾搭男人进门。”

第二章 设计毁名声(2)

赵小丫？围在赵家门外的几个村民面面相觑，就赵小丫那瘦弱胆小的样子还能做出勾搭男人这等事？

“我说婶子，那可是你闺女，可别搞不清楚就坏了自个儿闺女的清白。”开口的是住在隔壁的柳嫂子，她嫁进大山村没几年，跟赵小丫不熟，却对不多话，逢人总是笑着的她印象很好，忍不住说句公道话。

“我是她娘，还会冤枉她不成？”刘彩凤不客气的回呛，“这个死丫头，看我今天不好好教训教训。你是聋啦？赵小丫，还不滚出来！”

见没有动静，刘彩凤直接带人推开赵小丫的房门，阴暗的房里只隐约看到床上躺了人，她一个剑步上前，掌就拍了下去，“丢人现眼的贱丫头，还不给我起来！”

赵雪睡得正熟，平白挨了记，迷迷糊糊的睁开眼，还没来得及回过神，又是个巴掌往脸上招呼，这痛令她眼眶红，委屈的唤道：“娘？你怎么打我？”

听到赵雪的声音，刘彩凤的身子僵，低下头定眼看，这看还得了，竟然是自己的宝贝大闺女！

她吓得脸白，这房里挤进了不少人，更别提院子里还有不少看热闹的，少说也有十多个人。

刘彩凤脑子空，连忙将手上的被子拉，将赵雪包得密实。

被人声吵醒的李虎揉了揉眼睛坐了起来，看到李大婶，愣愣的唤了声，“娘。”

“你们瞧瞧，我家虎子真在这里！”李大婶没察觉刘彩凤的不对劲，径自嚷嚷着，“真是不要脸，竟然还拖着我家虎子躺同张床，盖个被窝。”

“还真是。”看热闹的村民下窃窃私语了起来，“真没想到，平时看着小丫可不像这样的人……”

李虎被李大婶给拉下床，他想起了她的交代，也跟着嚷道：“娘，我媳妇儿……虎子要媳妇！”

“娘知道。”李大婶赞赏的看了傻儿子眼，也不顾刘彩凤神色不自在，只道：“我说赵家嫂子，事情既然到了这地步，咱们李家是明理人，也不为难你们，改明儿个我就派媒婆过来定个日子接赵小丫，成不成？”

“成！当然成。”刘彩凤此刻岂有不应的道理，虽不知为何是赵雪躺在赵小丫的床上，但现在没必要追问，只要将罪名给钉死在赵小丫身上就是，“我们这门亲事就说定了。”

“好。”事情如了愿，李大婶笑开怀。

躺在床上的赵雪整个人僵硬地动不动，死死的咬住下唇，她知道如今万万不能让人知道躺在床上的是她，不然她这辈子就完了。

李大婶笑咧了嘴，正打算趁着人多谈谈嫁妆事，如今赵小丫被捉到和她儿子在张床上，只能嫁他们李家，她自然得多少讨回点银两。

就在这个时候，外头响起了阵不小的惊呼声。

“这不是小丫吗？”说话的正是柳嫂子，她看着睡眼惺忪出现在灶房门口的赵小丫，几个大步拉住人，“你怎么在这里？你娘说你在床上藏了个男人，正闹着呢。”

赵小丫一脸无辜的眨了眨大眼睛，“柳嫂子，你说什么？我听不懂，我直在灶房里。昨儿个夜里我本要给我爹和姊姊抬水进屋擦身子，谁知道太累了，不知不觉睡着，直到听到外头吵闹才醒过来。”

柳嫂子闻言双眼闪着光亮，“你是说你从昨夜就直在灶房里？”

赵小丫点了点头。

“你在灶房，那你床上躺的人是谁？”

方才在灶房里，赵小丫将外头的动静听得一清二楚，她知道若她不出面，那对母女肯定会将失贞的罪名安在自己身上，所以选在外头聚集了许多村民时现身，如今众目睽睽，赵雪别想安然脱身。

上辈子她承受的苦难，就送回给赵雪。

赵小丫侧着头老实回答，“可能是姊姊，昨夜姊姊说要跟我聊聊，所以我让她去我房里等着。”

外头的声音清楚的传进屋里，刘彩凤只觉得眼前阵黑。

李大婶闻言有些糊涂，将挡着视线的人推开，果然见到外头的人是赵小丫。

上次刘彩凤有把赵小丫带来给她瞧过，瘦瘦黑黑又长得普通，但看在她手脚俐落、能干活的分上，她也不计较长相。

如今赵小丫不在床上，那床上……

李大婶的目光落在刘彩凤死命护着的被子上，想到赵家还有另个闺女，年纪小小就艳名远播，她心头乐，立刻上前要将被子拉开。

“你做什么？”刘彩凤吼道。

“让我瞧瞧。”李大婶坚持要扯开被子，跟刘彩凤推拉了起来。

李虎在旁见了，也跟着扯被子，嘴巴还不停的吼着，“媳妇，我要媳妇！”

“放手，你这个死傻子。”刘彩凤怕李虎真把被子扯开，急得巴掌挥了过去。

李虎被打了巴掌，先是傻，最后忍不住哭出声，“娘，好疼。”

李大婶就这么个独苗，虽是个傻的，但也是摆在心尖上，听李虎喊疼，立刻护犊子的吼道：“杀千刀的！你敢打我儿子，看我怎么收拾你！”

屋子里乱成团，刘彩凤死命的护着被子，白白的挨了李大婶好几下，气得牙痒痒。

赵小丫连忙挤进去，“娘、婶子，你们别打了。”

她试图将人给拉开，却像是不经意被绊了下，手胡乱的扯，用力扯开被子，直接跌倒在地。

赵雪只感觉眼前亮，整个人登时显露在众人的目光之中。

“瞧！真是赵雪！”

惊呼声响起，赵小丫连忙起身拿着被子重新将赵雪盖上，“姊姊，都是我笨手笨脚，对不起！姊姊，我给你盖回去。”

赵雪看到众人就知道完了，双手挥用力的推开赵小丫，“滚开！不用你假好心。”

赵小丫被推倒在地，无辜的双眼含着泪。
content_en:
It was dark when I came in last night, but now I took a closer look at the small courtyard. It was neatly tidied up. It seemed that the Zhao family was living a good life relying on Father Zhao's craftsmanship.

Although Zhao Xiaoya was not favored, it was impossible for the Zhao family to not even have a dowry. She paid fifty taels of silver to marry her precious son, and most of the family property was lost.

After sizing up the Zhao family for a long time, Aunt Li made up her mind to bring some back.

She had some concerns in her mind, so she pretended to slap the door panel hard, which seemed harsh in the quiet morning.

Liu Caifeng frowned when she heard the noise outside. Then she heard Aunt Li's roar and immediately came back to her senses, remembering the big show she had prepared.

She quickly stood up and pushed Father Zhao next to her, but today he slept like a dead pig. She then remembered that in order to prevent him from falling asleep and causing bad things when he woke up, he had been drugged. No wonder he couldn't wake up.

"Good-for-nothing." Liu Caifeng spat, put on her shoes and hurried out. Stepping out, she immediately raised her voice and pretended to shout, "Who is it? You came to the door so early in the morning to make a noise!"

Aunt Li's eyes lit up when she heard Liu Caifeng's voice, and she immediately replied: "Hurry up and hand over my tiger son!"

"What Huzi? Aren't you the sister-in-law of the Li family? Why, you came to our Zhao family looking for your son?"

"Huzi said last night that he would come to your Zhao's house to play with his wife. He didn't go back all night. Please open the door quickly and call Huzi out."

The sound of the two singing together was particularly clear in the quiet early morning. Several neighboring houses had been awakened, and they couldn't help but curiously poked their heads in to take a look.

"What kind of tiger is in my house? Don't talk nonsense."

"Isn't that right? You won't know until you go in and look for it."

"It's really embarrassing." When Liu Caifeng saw people gathering outside the door, she immediately looked furious, "Zhao Xiaoya, that damn girl, I know how restless she is. She knows how to seduce men into the house at such a young age."

Chapter 2 Designing to ruin reputation (2)

Zhao Xiaoya?Several villagers gathered outside Zhao's house looked at each other in confusion. How could Zhao Xiaoya, who was so thin and timid, do such a thing as seducing a man?

"Auntie, she is your daughter. Don't ruin your daughter's innocence by being confused." The person who spoke was Sister-in-law Liu who lived next door. She had only been married to Dashan Village for a few years and was not familiar with Zhao Xiaoya. However, she had a good impression of her who didn't talk much and always smiled when meeting everyone. She couldn't help but say something fair.

"I am her mother, how can I still accuse her unjustly?" Liu Caifeng replied rudely, "This damn girl, see if I don't teach you a lesson today. Are you deaf? Zhao Xiaoya, get out of here!"

Seeing that there was no movement, Liu Caifeng directly led people to push open the door of Zhao Xiaoya's room. In the dark room, she could only vaguely see someone lying on the bed. She stepped forward with a sword step and slapped her down with her palm, "You shameless bitch, why don't you get up!"

Zhao Xue was sleeping soundly and was slapped in vain. She opened her eyes in a daze, but before she could recover, she was slapped on the face again. The pain made her eyes red, and she called out aggrievedly: "Mom? Why did you hit me?"

Hearing Zhao Xue's voice, Liu Caifeng's body stiffened, and she lowered her head to take a closer look. It was amazing, she turned out to be his precious eldest daughter!

She turned pale with fright. There were many people crowded into the room, not to mention there were many spectators in the yard, at least a dozen people.

Liu Caifeng's mind was empty, so she quickly pulled the quilt in her hands and wrapped Zhao Xue tightly.

Li Hu, who was awakened by the sound of people, rubbed his eyes and sat up. When he saw Aunt Li, he called out blankly, "Mom."

"Look, my tiger cub is really here!" Aunt Li didn't notice anything was wrong with Liu Caifeng and yelled, "It's so shameless that she dragged my tiger cub to lie on the same bed and cover her with a quilt."

"It's true." The villagers watching the excitement whispered, "I didn't expect that Xiaoya doesn't look like this person..."

Li Hu was pulled out of bed by Aunt Li. He remembered her explanation and shouted: "Mom, my wife... Huzi wants a wife!"

"Mom knows." Aunt Li glanced at her stupid son with admiration, and ignored Liu Caifeng's uncomfortable expression and said: "Sister-in-law of the Zhao family, since the matter has reached this point, our Li family is a sensible person and will not embarrass you. I will send a matchmaker to set a date to pick up Zhao Xiaoya tomorrow. Can it be done?"

"Yes! Of course." Is there any reason Liu Caifeng shouldn't be right at this moment? Although she doesn't know why Zhao Xue is lying on Zhao Xiaoya's bed, there is no need to ask now, as long as the crime is pinned on Zhao Xiaoya, "Our marriage is settled."

"Okay." Things went as planned, and Aunt Li smiled heartily.

Zhao Xue, who was lying on the bed, was stiff and motionless, biting her lower lip. She knew that she must not let anyone know that it was her who was lying on the bed, otherwise her life would be over.

Aunt Li grinned and was planning to take advantage of the crowd to talk about the dowry. Now that Zhao Xiaoya was caught in the same bed with her son, she could only marry into their Li family. Naturally, she had to get some money back.

At this moment, there was a loud exclamation outside.

"Isn't this Xiaoya?" It was Sister-in-law Liu who spoke. She looked at Zhao Xiaoya who appeared sleepily at the door of the kitchen, and grabbed him with a few strides, "Why are you here? Your mother said you were hiding a man in the bed and were making a fuss."

Zhao Xiaoya blinked her eyes innocently, "Sister-in-law Liu, what are you talking about? I don't understand, I've been in the kitchen. Last night I was going to carry water into the house for my father and sister to wipe themselves, but I was so tired that I fell asleep without realizing it. I didn't wake up until I heard the noise outside."

Sister-in-law Liu's eyes sparkled when she heard this, "You mean you've been in the kitchen since last night?"

Zhao Xiaoya nodded.

"You are in the kitchen, then who is lying on your bed?"

Zhao Xiaoya was in the kitchen just now and heard clearly what was going on outside. She knew that if she didn't come forward, the mother and daughter would definitely blame her for losing their virginity, so she chose to show up when many villagers gathered outside. Now that everyone was watching, Zhao Xue couldn't escape safely.

The suffering she endured in her previous life was sent back to Zhao Xue.

Zhao Xiaoya tilted her head and answered honestly, "Maybe it's my sister. My sister said she wanted to talk to me last night, so I asked her to wait in my room."

The sound from outside came clearly into the room, and Liu Caifeng felt that her eyes were dark.

Aunt Li was a little confused when she heard this. She pushed away the person blocking her sight, and sure enough she saw that the person outside was Zhao Xiaoya.

Liu Caifeng brought Zhao Xiaoya to her last time. She was thin, dark and ordinary looking, but because of her nimble hands and feet and her ability to work, she didn't care about her appearance.

Now that Zhao Xiaoya is not in bed, that bed...

Aunt Li's eyes fell on the quilt that Liu Caifeng was guarding. She was happy when she thought that the Zhao family had another daughter who was famous at a young age and immediately stepped forward to pull the quilt away.

"What are you doing?" Liu Caifeng shouted.

"Let me take a look." Aunt Li insisted on pulling away the quilt and started pushing and pulling with Liu Caifeng.

Li Hu saw him nearby and pulled up the quilt too, shouting, "Daughter-in-law, I want a wife!"

"Let go, you idiot." Liu Caifeng was afraid that Li Hu would really pull the quilt away, so she slapped him with her hand in panic.

Li Hu was slapped. He felt stupid at first, and finally couldn't help crying, "Mom, it hurts so much."

Aunt Li is such an independent child. Although she is stupid, she is still at the forefront of her heart. When she heard Li Hu cry out for pain, she immediately yelled protectively: "Kill with a thousand swords! If you dare to hit my son, see how I deal with you!"

The room was in chaos, Liu Caifeng was holding on to the quilt with all her strength, and was beaten several times in vain by Aunt Li, making her teeth itch with anger.

Zhao Xiaoya quickly squeezed in, "Mom, aunt, please stop fighting."

She tried to pull him away, but she seemed to have tripped accidentally. She pulled randomly with her hands, pulled the quilt apart hard, and fell directly to the ground.

Zhao Xue only felt her eyes light up, and her whole body was immediately exposed to everyone's gaze.

"Look! It's really Zhao Xue!"

There was an exclamation, and Zhao Xiaoya quickly stood up and covered Zhao Xue with the quilt again, "Sister, it's all my clumsiness, I'm sorry! Sister, I'll cover you back up."

Zhao Xue knew it was over when she saw everyone, and pushed Zhao Xiaoya away with both hands, "Get out of here! You don't need to pretend to be kind."

Zhao Xiaoya was pushed to the ground, with tears in her innocent eyes.
